scope: Bounded scanner expiry/restart recovery over real Flask HTTP and isolated SQLite; all providers are fake

environment.browser_plugin: Not available; used the documented Playwright CLI path
environment.frontend: Isolated static Expo export in the dedicated system temp test directory
environment.database: Dedicated system temp SQLite plus database-specific test marker; retained for audit, test server stopped
environment.authentication: AUTH_REQUIRED=true with test-only token verifier and seeded synthetic user
environment.clock: Real time plus persisted forward-only offset shared by scan/snapshot/confirmation/preview repositories and preview service

changes: Candidate lookup failures now have localized feedback and explicit temporary-error retry
Terminal expired/stale responses invalidate only the current matching reference, retain detections and timestamp, and prompt rescan
Temporary confirmation failure retains identical pending request and idempotency key
Candidate parser validates the expiry field structurally; server clock remains the authority instead of the device clock
Test server supports guarded same-file resume and authenticated deterministic clock/provider controls

browser_qa.other_console_output: Existing login form DOM verbose notice

execution_notes: Automatic approval review blocked a test Expo development server command and an agent hidden background smoke command before execution; used a safer isolated static export served by foreground/session test Flask instead
First slow manual restart crossed original 120-second TTL and correctly failed; continuously orchestrated retry completed within TTL without extending it
Programmatic chooser plus redundant CLI upload caused test-only Expo removeChild errors; final fresh session used CLI click/upload exclusively and had no runtime exceptions
An initial wrong-heading wait and a redundant wait after terminal cleanup timed out; corrected the test sequence
Normal Metro build reused a previous test-config transform; final same-origin flags-disabled export cleared cache and verified the resulting bundle
An intermediate cache-cleared export was intentionally canceled to add explicit same-origin configuration, then completed successfully
limitations: Fake-provider browser and SQLite evidence does not establish food recognition or nutrition accuracy
Already-rendered previews are historical read-only snapshots; no automatic expiry-removal contract was added
Persisted active status alone does not establish validity; runtime expiry and current authorization are still required, and no timed purge is claimed
Confirmation retains original candidate snapshot expiry; a newer issued scan does not extend confirmation lifetime
Physical camera, another device over Tailscale, live providers, source-rights admission, profile acceptance and real dietary-record writes remain unverified in this batch
SQLite-only and the original six workflow boundaries remain unchanged; all production enrichment flags remain disabled
